claims.quote: The least pencilfish, Nannostomus minimus, is a tiny lebiasinid from the Potaro and Mazaruni systems of the Essequibo basin in Guyana.
Type locality is 'Erukin, Guyana' which appears to correspond to a creek of that name within the Potaro River system, with one specimen also deriving from Amatuk Falls.
